title: Untenable
summary: UNTEN'ABLE, adjective 1. Not tenable; that cannot be held in possession; as an untenable post or fort. 2. That cannot be maintained or supported; not defensible; as an untenable doctrine; untenable gr

inlines.v: UNTEN'ABLE, adjective 1. Not tenable; that cannot be held in possession; as an untenable post or fort. 2. That cannot be maintained or supported; not defensible; as an untenable doctrine; untenable ground in argument.
